# Stellar-system reference fixtures

Research-only benchmark inputs mirrored from permissively licensed upstream projects.

## VPLanet

Upstream:
https://github.com/VirtualPlanetaryLaboratory/vplanet

Pinned research commit:
dd55da7e1ff063f0ea7048f91c9d2d97d6ba9a5d

License: MIT.

Included fixtures:

- SS_NBody/Sun.in
- SS_NBody/Mercury.in
- SS_NBody/Venus.in
- SS_NBody/Earth.in
- SS_NBody/Mars.in
- SS_NBody/Jupiter.in
- SS_NBody/Saturn.in
- SS_NBody/Uranus.in
- SS_NBody/Neptune.in
- EarthClimate/earth.in
- EarthInterior/earth.in
- MagmOc_Earth/Earth.in

Purpose: calibration and regression testing of Elite's future StellarSystemGenerator and CelestialBodyGenerator.

These are not production dependencies and do not provide procedural surface geometry.
